Want to Shape the Future of Mobile Cameras?

Are you driven by vision?  Do you want to make an impact on the next generation of smartphones?

join us.

At Corephotonics, we are developing the world’s most advanced cameras for smartphones. Our revolutionary camera designs enable millions of users to capture their lives in beautiful and vivid pictures and videos. Our mission is to improve image quality and deliver features and capabilities that were only available to professional photographers to the mass market of smartphone users.

We are bringing together experts in a wide range of technological fields, including:

  • Various AI methodologies: computer vision, recognition, tracking, sensor fusion and autonomous features.
  • Computational photography – tightly coupled optical designs and computational image processing
  • UI/UX development for smartphones
  • Optics and imaging
  • Micro electromechanical systems.
  • System integration, testing and QA.

COREPHOTONICS IN VIDEOS

To give a peek under the hood of life at CorePhotonics, we have curated a selection of videos from fun days, tutorials, and product demonstrations.

As part of Samsung Electronics group, Corephotonics' culture combines a startup atmosphere, with large coporate robustness and benefits. We encourage training, self-development and promotion. We encourage gender equality. Most importantly, we encourage our employees to create, invent, collaborate and bring out the best of their talents.

SENIOR RESEARCHER

We are seeking a talented and driven researcher to lead the development of groundbreaking diffractive optical components based on diffraction, meta-structures, and similar configurations. This is a unique opportunity for an expert from academy or industry to spearhead cutting-edge innovation in this dynamic field.
